description: Architects Registration Board - Notify the list of Chartered Architects and Architectural Licentiates, registered in the ARB for the year 2018
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the registration and regulation of architects under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act, No. 14 of 1996. It involves the publication of a statutory list of qualified professionals (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) who are legally authorized to practice architecture, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. This aligns with Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with the implementation of a specific act and the maintenance of a professional register.
